summary: The diff adds a React router app shell, nav/auth gating components, several React Query hooks, and a Motoko actor with basic prediction/detection/recommendation functions. However, several BuildRequest acceptance criteria are not evidenced in the shown diff (notably stable storage + typed error variants in Motoko, backend validation for disease uploads, charts/visualizations requirements, and documentation/static demo datasets). The diff also introduces some unrequested admin/access-control and profile-setup functionality.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist per-user history across canister upgrades using stable storage (stable variables) and no external DB.
missing_requirements.reason: In the shown backend code, histories are stored in `let cropYieldHistory = Map.empty<Principal, List.List<CropYieldResult>>();` (and similar), with no `stable var` or upgrade hooks evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: All backend endpoints return structured error variants for invalid inputs (typed error responses), rather than trapping.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend uses `Runtime.trap("Unauthorized...")` for auth failures, and no typed `Result`/error variants are shown for invalid inputs.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must validate uploaded leaf image size/type and return a structured error for invalid inputs (missing image/too large/unsupported type).
missing_requirements.reason: `detectDisease(leafImage : Storage.ExternalBlob)` unconditionally returns a result with hardcoded disease info; no size/type validation or typed error response is evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Crop Yield Prediction page must render at least one graph visualization and include a sample agriculture dataset in-repo referenced in code.
missing_requirements.reason: No chart rendering or sample dataset file/usage is evidenced in the provided diff snippet (only routing and hooks/components are shown).

missing_requirements.requirement: Visualizations page must show charts (yield accuracy trend/distribution, disease confidence distribution, irrigation yes/no breakdown) using a charting library and data from real stored history returned by the backend.
missing_requirements.reason: The Visualizations page implementation and any charting library usage are not evidenced in the provided diff snippet (only the route registration is shown).

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide production-ready README documentation with local run steps (dfx), module descriptions, constraints explanation, and how to test each module from the frontend; add explanatory comments where needed.
missing_requirements.reason: No README or documentation changes are shown in the diff summary (all files listed are code files; no README evidenced).

missing_requirements.requirement: Include in-repo static demo artifacts: (1) a small crop yield dataset file, and (2) a disease label→treatment mapping file; frontend loads them without external network calls.
missing_requirements.reason: Aside from referencing a generated logo path in the nav, no dataset/mapping asset files or code loading them are evidenced in the provided diff snippet.

missing_requirements.requirement: Allow authenticated users to clear their history; backend deletes stored entries for that principal; UI updates immediately after clearing.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend includes a clear-history hook that calls `actor.clearHistory()`, but the backend `clearHistory` implementation is not evidenced in the shown/truncated backend code, nor is principal-scoped deletion shown.

hallucinated_features.description: Custom access-control initialization using a secret URL parameter (`caffeineAdminToken`) and backend authorization mixins beyond Internet Identity gating.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires Internet Identity authentication and principal association, but does not request an admin-secret initialization flow or secret URL parameter-based access control.

hallucinated_features.description: Blob-storage mixin inclusion and storing the full uploaded leaf image blob in history results (`leafImage : Storage.ExternalBlob`).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires sending an image to backend and returning diseaseName/confidence/treatment; it does not require persisting the raw image blob inside history results.

hallucinated_features.description: Profile setup modal and user profile hooks/components.
hallucinated_features.reason: User profile setup is not requested in any REQ; only II auth + module flows + history are requested.
